About

Raised in the sunshine.
Refined in the city.

I grew up in Florida — barefoot, beach-bound, and genuinely unaware that I'd spend pivotal years building global campaigns in New York City. Manhattan sharpened me in ways I didn't know I needed.

At Deutsch Inc., I worked on one of the most recognized software launches in consumer history — Microsoft Office. At Grok, I managed worldwide campaigns for VMware while the agency earned its place on the Inc. 500 with 1,077% revenue growth over three years. I was promoted from Assistant to Account Executive in under a month — a reflection of how seriously I take the work.

Eventually, I came home — by choice and with intention. I founded DG Media in 2019 because I believed that Fortune 500-caliber thinking shouldn't be gated behind a Fortune 500 budget. Today I work directly with B2B and B2C brands as an embedded marketing partner and AI systems architect — no intermediaries, no overhead, no compromise on quality.

Certified in Agentic AI through DeepLearning.AI, I design systems that work continuously and produce outcomes that are measurable and verifiable. Everything you see on this page reflects that standard.
